text_en: “Very truly, I tell you, anyone who does not enter the sheepfold by the gate but climbs in by another way is a thief and a bandit.
text_cn: “我实实在在告诉你们：凡不由门进入羊栈，而由别处爬进去的，便是贼，是强盗。

text_en: The one who enters by the gate is the shepherd of the sheep.
text_cn: 由门进去的，才是羊的牧人。

text_en: The gatekeeper opens the gate for him, and the sheep hear his voice. He calls his own sheep by name and leads them out.
text_cn: 看门的给他开门，羊听他的声音；他按着名字呼唤自己的羊，并引领出来。

text_en: When he has brought out all his own, he goes ahead of them, and the sheep follow him because they know his voice.
text_cn: 当他把羊放出来以后，就走在羊前面，羊也跟随他，因为认得他的声音。

text_en: They will not follow a stranger, but they will run from him because they do not know the voice of strangers. ”
text_cn: 羊决不跟随陌生人，反而逃避他，因为羊不认得陌生人的声音。”

text_en: Jesus used this figure of speech with them, but they did not understand what he was saying to them.
text_cn: 耶稣给他们讲了这个比喻，他们却不明白给他们所讲的是什么。

text_en: So again Jesus said to them, “Very truly, I tell you, I am the gate for the sheep.
text_cn: 于是耶稣又对他们说：“我实实在在告诉你们：我是羊的门；

text_en: All who came before me are thieves and bandits; but the sheep did not listen to them.
text_cn: 凡在我以先来的，都是贼和强盗，羊没有听从他们。

text_en: I am the gate. Whoever enters by me will be saved, and will come in and go out and find pasture.
text_cn: 我就是门，谁若经过我进来，必得安全；可以进，可以出，可以找着草场。

text_en: The thief comes only to steal and kill and destroy. I came that they may have life, and have it abundantly.
text_cn: 贼来，无非是为偷窃、杀害、毁灭；我来，却是为叫他们获得生命，且获得更丰富的生命。

text_en: “I am the good shepherd. The good shepherd lays down his life for the sheep.
text_cn: 我是善牧：善牧为羊舍掉自己的性命。

text_en: The hired hand, who is not the shepherd and does not own the sheep, sees the wolf coming and leaves the sheep and runs away—and the wolf snatches them and scatters them.
text_cn: 佣工，因不是牧人，羊也不是他自己的，一看见狼来，便弃羊逃跑──狼就抓住羊，把羊赶散了，

text_en: The hired hand runs away because a hired hand does not care for the sheep.
text_cn: 因为他是佣工，对羊漠不关心。

text_en: I am the good shepherd. I know my own and my own know me,
text_cn: 我是善牧，我认识我的羊，我的羊也认识我，

text_en: just as the Father knows me and I know the Father. And I lay down my life for the sheep.
text_cn: 正如父认识我，我也认识父一样；我并且为羊舍掉我的性命。

text_en: I have other sheep that do not belong to this fold. I must bring them also, and they will listen to my voice. So there will be one flock, one shepherd.
text_cn: 我还有别的羊，还不属于这一栈，我也该把他们引来，他们要听我的声音，这样，将只有一个羊群，一个牧人。

text_en: For this reason the Father loves me, because I lay down my life in order to take it up again.
text_cn: 父爱我，因为我舍掉我的性命，为再取回它来：

text_en: No one takes it from me, but I lay it down of my own accord. I have power to lay it down, and I have power to take it up again. I have received this command from my Father. ”
text_cn: 谁也不能夺去我的性命，而是我甘心情愿舍掉它；我有权舍掉它，我也有权再取回它来：这是由我父所接受的命令。”

text_en: Again the Jews were divided because of these words.
text_cn: 因了这些话，犹太人中间又发生了纷争；

text_en: Many of them were saying, “He has a demon and is out of his mind. Why listen to him? ”
text_cn: 他们中有许多人说：“他附魔发疯，为什么还听他呢？”

text_en: Others were saying, “These are not the words of one who has a demon. Can a demon open the eyes of the blind? ”
text_cn: 另有些人说：“这话不是附魔的人所能说的；难道魔鬼能开瞎子的眼睛么？”

text_en: At that time the festival of the Dedication took place in Jerusalem. It was winter,
text_cn: 那时，在耶路撒冷举行重建节，正是冬天。

text_en: and Jesus was walking in the temple, in the portico of Solomon.
text_cn: 耶稣徘徊于圣殿内撒罗满游廊下。

text_en: So the Jews gathered around him and said to him, “How long will you keep us in suspense? If you are the Messiah, tell us plainly. ”
text_cn: 犹太人围起他来，向他说：“你使我们的心神悬疑不定，要到几时呢？你如果是默西亚，就坦白告诉我们罢！”

text_en: Jesus answered, “I have told you, and you do not believe. The works that I do in my Father’s name testify to me;
text_cn: 耶稣答复说：“我已告诉了你们，你们却不相信；我以我父的名所作的工作，为我作证，

text_en: but you do not believe, because you do not belong to my sheep.
text_cn: 但你们还是不信，因为你们不是属于我的羊。

text_en: My sheep hear my voice. I know them, and they follow me.
text_cn: 我的羊听我的声音，我也认识他们，他们也跟随我；

text_en: I give them eternal life, and they will never perish. No one will snatch them out of my hand.
text_cn: 我赐予他们永生，他们永远不会丧亡；谁也不能从我手中把他们夺去。

text_en: What my Father has given me is greater than all else, and no one can snatch it out of the Father’s hand.
text_cn: 我那赐给我羊群的父，超越一切，为此，谁也不能从我父手里将他们夺去。

text_en: The Father and I are one. ”
text_cn: 我与父原是一体。”

text_en: The Jews took up stones again to stone him.
text_cn: 犹太人又拿起石头来，要砸死他。

text_en: Jesus replied, “I have shown you many good works from the Father. For which of these are you going to stone me? ”
text_cn: 耶稣向他们说：“我赖我父给你们显示了许多善事，为了哪一件，你们要砸死我呢？”

text_en: The Jews answered, “It is not for a good work that we are going to stone you, but for blasphemy, because you, though only a human being, are making yourself God. ”
text_cn: 犹太人回答说：“为了善事，我们不会砸死你；而是为了亵渎的话，因为你是人，却把你自己当作天主。”

text_en: Jesus answered, “Is it not written in your law, ‘I said, you are gods’?
text_cn: 耶稣却向他们说：“在你们的法律上不是记载着：‘我说过：你们是神’么？

text_en: If those to whom the word of God came were called ‘gods’—and the scripture cannot be annulled—
text_cn: 如果，那些承受天主话的，天主尚且称他们为神──而经书是不能废弃的──

text_en: can you say that the one whom the Father has sanctified and sent into the world is blaspheming because I said, ‘I am God’s Son’?
text_cn: 那么，父所祝圣并派遣到世界上来的，因为说过：我是天主子，你们就说：你说亵渎的话么？

text_en: If I am not doing the works of my Father, then do not believe me.
text_cn: 假使我不作我父的工作，你们就不必信我；

text_en: But if I do them, even though you do not believe me, believe the works, so that you may know and understand that the Father is in me and I am in the Father. ”
text_cn: 但若是我作了，你们纵然不肯信我，至少要信这些工作，如此你们必定认出父在我内，我在父内。”

text_en: Then they tried to arrest him again, but he escaped from their hands.
text_cn: 他们又企图捉拿他，他却从他们手中走脱了。

text_en: He went away again across the Jordan to the place where John had been baptizing earlier, and he remained there.
text_cn: 耶稣又到约但河对岸，若翰先前施洗的地方去了，并住在那里。

text_en: Many came to him, and they were saying, “John performed no sign, but everything that John said about this man was true. ”
text_cn: 有许多人来到他那里说：“若翰固然没有行过神迹，但若翰关于这人所说的一切，都是真的。”

text_en: And many believed in him there.
text_cn: 许多人就在那里信了耶稣。
